location_qualifier: east of the Périers area; point = Périers
current_activity: 5th Parachute Division, controlling only one regiment, east of the Périers area
notes: Event date: Breakout and Pursuit ch. 12 p. 227 gives the German order of battle on the morning of 24 July 1944, the day before the Cobra bombardment: immediately east of the 2d SS and 17th SS in the Périers area was the 5th Parachute Division, recently arrived from Brittany and controlling only one regiment. Location: east of Périers. Location approximate: the Green Book gives the sector, not the command post of the unit.

notes: Event date: Schramm, OKW war diary (KTB 1944, western theater, p. 366), entry of 4 September: the First Parachute Army receives the Fallschirmjäger divisions 3, 5 and 6: "Div.en 3, 5 und 6" ...
